description: This file contains the implementation of the ArrayArgumentProcessor class, which handles processing array arguments for calculation methods within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It manages different types of array inputs such as vectors, matrices, and combinations for spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: ArrayArgumentProcessor
classes.description: A class that processes array arguments for calculation functions, handling different array structures such as vectors and matrices, for use in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: processArguments
methods.description: Main method to process and evaluate array arguments based on their structure (single array, vector, matrix, or combinations).

methods.name: evaluateVectorMatrixPair
methods.description: Evaluates a pair of vector and matrix inputs, returning combined results by applying the provided method element-wise.

methods.name: evaluateMatrixPair
methods.description: Evaluates a pair of matrices, applying the method element-wise across corresponding elements.

methods.name: evaluateVectorPair
methods.description: Evaluates two vectors, producing a Cartesian product of their elements by applying the method.

methods.name: evaluateNthArgumentAsArray
methods.description: Processes the nth argument as an array, applying the method over each element of that array.
